invariants.why: the step climbs exactly one level; z+2 needs two steps or a jump
routing the step through canCross looks like deduplication and breaks stairs
the jump parabola is screen-only; collision always tests the integer model z
sliding is decided since onda3: the box sweeps per axis (X first, then Y), so blocking one axis does not block the other — a straight wall hit clamps the face and zeroes the velocity
a fractional z means the calculation belongs in screen space, not the model
trace.ts is an input replay; the name invites confusion with voxel traversal
